subject: Evidence of leaks may warrant further investigation.
rationale: T001 identifies support messages mentioning leaks and permits limited voluntary follow-up, supporting leaks as a possible subject of further inquiry. The claim licenses only consideration of investigation; it does not establish confirmed leakage, its contribution to declining repeat purchases, or an effective remedy. The transferred alignment mechanism supports checking chronology, not diagnosing leak causes, and the claim requires no such diagnostic inference.
